Metadata.title: Spirit of Santa for Stores
Metadata.description: List gift items for local kids and get paid when they earn them.

HomePage.title: Spirit of Santa for Stores
HomePage.intro: List up to 50 gift items. Kids earn them with good deeds, and you get paid.

RegisterPage.title: List your store on Spirit of Santa
RegisterPage.intro: Local kids earn gifts with good deeds. Sign up, add up to 50 items, and bill us the agreed wholesale cost when an item is earned.
RegisterPage.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
RegisterPage.descriptionHint: What do you sell? Families will see this once you're approved.
RegisterPage.sentBody: We've sent a confirmation link. Confirm your email, then sign in to set up your items while we review your store.

StoreAgreement.title: Store discount and guarantee agreement
StoreAgreement.p1: You list items at your normal retail price. Each item's price in Christmas Magic equals its retail price in dollars.
StoreAgreement.p2: Spirit of Santa agrees a discount off retail with your store when we approve it. When a child's item is funded, you bill Spirit of Santa the agreed wholesale cost (retail price minus that discount).
StoreAgreement.p3: You guarantee listed items stay available at the listed price for the season, or you offer an equal or better substitute.
StoreAgreement.p4: Spirit of Santa keeps the difference between retail and wholesale to run the program.
StoreAgreement.p5: Spirit of Santa pays your invoices by check or another method outside the app. No bank details are stored in the app.
StoreAgreement.accept: I have read and accept the store discount and guarantee agreement.

AcceptInvitePage.title: Accept your store invitation
AcceptInvitePage.intro: Spirit of Santa has invited {storeName}. Set up your owner account to start listing items.
AcceptInvitePage.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
AcceptInvitePage.done: You're all set! Your store is approved and your account is ready.
AcceptInvitePage.invalid: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Ask Spirit of Santa to send a new one.

Dashboard.title: Store dashboard
Dashboard.noAccess: Your account isn't connected to a store right now. If you were removed by the store owner, ask them to invite you again.

statusHelp.pending: We're reviewing your store. You can set up your profile, photos and team now. Families will see your store once it's approved.
statusHelp.invited: Your store invitation hasn't been accepted yet.
statusHelp.approved: Your store is approved and visible to families.
statusHelp.suspended: Your store is suspended and hidden from families. Contact Spirit of Santa to resolve this.

Profile.title: Store profile
Profile.readOnly: Your store's profile can't be edited in its current status.
Profile.noPhotos: No photos yet. Add a photo of your storefront or products.
Profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. We remove location data from photos automatically.

Reps.title: Reps
Reps.intro: Reps are your staff. They can manage items and inventory, but only you can change prices, your profile and your team.
Reps.readOnly: Your team can't be changed in your store's current status.
Reps.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? They'll be signed out and lose access to your store.
Reps.inviteIntro: They'll get an email link (valid 7 days) to choose a name and password.
Reps.removed: Rep removed. They've been signed out.
Reps.inviteNeedsApproval: You can invite reps once your store is approved.

AcceptRepInvitePage.title: Join your store's team
AcceptRepInvitePage.intro: You've been invited to help manage {storeName} on Spirit of Santa.
AcceptRepInvitePage.name: Your name
AcceptRepInvitePage.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
AcceptRepInvitePage.done: You're all set! Sign in to start helping with your store's items.
AcceptRepInvitePage.invalid: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Ask the store owner to send a new one.

ErrorPage.title: Something went wrong
ErrorPage.body: That didn't work. Your changes may not have been saved. Please try again.

Items.title: Items
Items.windowOpen: Your item list is open for changes.
Items.windowClosed: Your item list is closed for changes right now (it's normally open January 1 – March 31). You can still update stock counts.
Items.readOnly: Items can't be changed while your store has this status.
Items.discountNote: Your agreed discount is {discount}. Wholesale is what you bill Spirit of Santa when an item is earned.
Items.engagementNote: Repeat views by the same visitor on the same day count once. Wish-list numbers are totals only: you'll never see which children chose an item. Locked-in items can't be removed and are yours to fulfil.
Items.repDraftNote: Your store owner will set the price before the item is listed.
Items.limitNote: You've reached the {limit}-item limit. Archive an item to add another.
Items.name: Item name
Items.priceHint: Your normal shelf price. Kids need this much Christmas Magic.
Items.repPriceNote: Only the store owner can set prices.
Items.created: Item added. You can add a photo now.
Items.wholesaleLine: Retail {price} · you bill Spirit of Santa {wholesale}
Items.archiveHelp: Removes it from your list and frees a slot. You can restore it later.
Items.restoreHelp: Puts it back on your list (if you're under the limit).
Items.confirmArchive: Archive {name}? It will be removed from your list.

Orders.title: Gift orders
Orders.intro: Gifts children have fully funded at your store. We never share anything about the children: use the reference code to match each package.
Orders.readyIntro: Please ship each one to Spirit of Santa {late, select, yes {as soon as possible} other {by {shipBy}, so it arrives for Christmas}}. Write its reference code on the package, then mark it shipped.
Orders.noAddress: Spirit of Santa hasn't set its shipping address yet. Please wait before shipping; we'll email you.
Orders.setAsideIntro: {open, select, yes {Fully funded today: they move to "Ready to ship" tomorrow.} other {Secured for a child: please keep one aside for each and don't ship yet. They move to "Ready to ship" on {from}.}}
Orders.outIntro: These were funded when you had none left. Spirit of Santa will contact you about a substitute.

errors.notFound: That order wasn't found. Reload the page.
errors.notReady: That gift can't be shipped right now (it may have been shipped already). Reload the page.
errors.notYet: That gift is held for December: it can be shipped from the date shown under "Held for December".
errors.tracking: Keep the tracking note under 100 characters.

Orders.owedNow: Owed to you now: {amount} for {count, plural, one {# gift} other {# gifts}} we've received.
Orders.paidLine: {amount} on {date} · {count, plural, one {# gift} other {# gifts}} · {method}
Orders.owedPending: {count, plural, one {# more gift is} other {# more gifts are}} received and waiting for Spirit of Santa to confirm your discount.
